boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 88 is an hourglass board with a blue center spine, a red zigzag hanging under it, and matched purple lock pods on both side walls. Start on the upper-right stack, clear the side locks next, and only then drop the orange beam and center spine through the throat into the lower basin.
landmarks: Block Out Level 88 is an hourglass board with a blue center spine, a red zigzag hanging under it, and matched purple lock pods on both side walls.
Start on the upper-right stack, clear the side locks next, and only then drop the orange beam and center spine through the throat into the lower basin.
The board mixes Green, Red, Orange and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Do not start from the bottom basin. This board opens from the neck downward.
If one lock pod is still on the wall, the blue spine is not ready to drop.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Trim the upper-right stack first so the right wall opens and its outer count starts dropping.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Use that new room to release the right purple lock pod, then clear the matching lock pod on the left wall.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Slide the long orange beam across the throat only after the blue center spine has one free side.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Drop the blue spine and the red zigzag through the neck into the lower basin.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the lower-left orange runway and the opposite orange tray once the center pieces are out of the way.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the last purple elbow plus the top-left green-and-yellow pieces through the opened side lanes.

failurePoints: Starting on the bottom orange trays before the upper-right stack and both side locks have opened the neck.
Moving the orange beam while the blue center spine is still pinned on both sides.
